note: Submodule of imageapi_optimize_webp. Implements template_preprocess_responsive_image() to add <source type=image/webp> entries to core responsive images, but only for image styles whose Image Optimize pipeline contains a processor with plugin id imageapi_optimize_webp (the WebP Deriver). No config/settings/permissions/plugins/Drush. Introspection reads a WebP pipeline's processor/quality (the prerequisite the submodule keys on); execution ensures the submodule is enabled and builds a WebP pipeline. Pipeline config is deleted via the config factory because deleting the pipeline entity fatals on this site (remote_stream_wrapper overrides ImageStyle without hasPipeline()). No node operations.

evals.prompt: What does the imageapi_optimize_webp_responsive submodule add to Drupal's core Responsive Image output?
evals.expected_output: It adds entries (with a .webp srcset) to the element rendered for core responsive image fields, so WebP-capable browsers get the smaller WebP derivatives. It prepends the WebP sources and disables the plain fallback path.

evals.prompt: Under what condition does imageapi_optimize_webp_responsive actually emit WebP sources for a responsive image style?
evals.expected_output: Only for image styles (mapped by the responsive image style) whose Image Optimize pipeline contains a processor with plugin id imageapi_optimize_webp (the WebP Deriver). If no mapped image style uses such a pipeline, the responsive image output is unchanged.

evals.prompt: Which Drupal theme preprocess hook does imageapi_optimize_webp_responsive implement to inject WebP sources, and does it need any configuration?
evals.expected_output: It implements template_preprocess_responsive_image(). It has no configuration of its own — enable it and ensure the responsive image style's image styles use a pipeline that includes the WebP Deriver processor.

evals.prompt: On this Drupal site there is an Image Optimize pipeline named 'iowr_intro'. imageapi_optimize_webp_responsive will only add WebP sources for image styles that use a pipeline containing a specific processor. Inspect the live pipeline and state which processor plugin id that is.
evals.expected_output: The pipeline imageapi_optimize.pipeline.iowr_intro contains a processor with id imageapi_optimize_webp (the WebP Deriver), which is exactly what the responsive submodule looks for.

evals.prompt: On this Drupal site the Image Optimize pipeline 'iowr_q' has the WebP Deriver processor used by imageapi_optimize_webp_responsive. Inspect the live pipeline and state the WebP quality value configured.
evals.expected_output: The imageapi_optimize_webp processor in imageapi_optimize.pipeline.iowr_q has data.quality = 85.

evals.prompt: On this Drupal site I want my responsive images to also offer WebP versions in the <picture> element for browsers that support it. Make sure the module that adds WebP sources to core responsive images is turned on.
evals.expected_output: Enable the imageapi_optimize_webp_responsive module (drush en imageapi_optimize_webp_responsive -y). It implements template_preprocess_responsive_image to add WebP sources for image styles whose pipeline includes the WebP Deriver.

evals.prompt: On this Drupal site, so that imageapi_optimize_webp_responsive can produce WebP sources, create an Image Optimize pipeline named 'iowr_task' that includes the imageapi_optimize_webp WebP Deriver processor. Apply it to the live site.
evals.expected_output: Create an imageapi_optimize_pipeline config entity 'iowr_task' (id key 'name') with a processor entry id imageapi_optimize_webp in its processors list, then save. Assigning that pipeline to the image styles used by a responsive image style makes the submodule emit WebP sources.
